triggerReason: The first successful automatic main delivery signed its evidence and portable bundle, but the follower receipt job classified declared generated reports as dirty before reaching the separately missing human-controlled signing key. The first candidate run then proved that a generic trim also removed the leading porcelain status column.
action: Keep source cleanliness fail closed for every unexpected path, explicitly classify only quality-workflow generated evidence outputs, preserve the first porcelain status column, expose unexpected paths in the manifest log, and preserve receipt signing and ingestion as external configuration.
outcome: Exact PR run 30683661198 and main run 30684112947 passed 280 tests, 28/28 browser scenarios, all deterministic/long-horizon/isolated gates and emitted dirty=false with no unexpected path. Main produced two Sigstore attestations, an immutable archive and atomically deployed 033272f1 without replacing PostgreSQL. Production browser checks passed; receipt followers now fail only because the human-controlled Ed25519 private key is not configured.
